skills.name: Everguard Oath
skills.description: Protects an ally in the front row, granting them a Shield equal to 400% of ATK for 6s, and reduces their DMG taken by 20% for the next 6s. Prioritizes the ally with [Golden Apple].

upgrades.level2: Shield and DMG reduction duration extends to 8s.
upgrades.level3: The target takes 40% reduced DMG for the duration.
upgrades.level4: Grants a Shield equal to 500% of ATK.

skills.name: Radiant Vitality
skills.description: Blesses the 1 weakest ally, restoring HP equal to 250% of ATK + 15% of the target's lost HP. This effect is cast one extra time on allies with [Golden Apple].

upgrades.level3: Restores 25% of the target's lost HP.

skills.name: Shared Divinity
skills.description: Passive: In battle, Idunn grants [Golden Apple] to the nearest front-row ally. ([Golden Apple]: Grants 10% of Idunn's ATK, HP, Armor, and M-RES.)

upgrades.level2: [Golden Apple] grants the target 15% of Idunn's ATK, HP, Armor, and M-RES.
upgrades.level3: While the [Golden Apple] target is alive, Idunn takes 50% reduced DMG.
upgrades.level4: [Golden Apple] grants the target 20% of Idunn's ATK, HP, Armor, and M-RES.

skills.name: Providence Moment
skills.description: Passive: When Idunn is about to fall, she summons a Golden Apple to cover herself, gaining a Shield equal to 75% of max HP for 5s. During this time, the Shield converts into her HP at a rate of 20% of her max HP per second. This effect can only be triggered once per battle.

upgrades.level2: Gains a Shield equal to 100% of max HP.
upgrades.level3: Idunn takes 70% reduced DMG while shielded.
upgrades.level4: Gains a Shield equal to 125% of max HP.

relic.name: Fruit of Eternity
relic.description: If the target of the Ultimate is an ally with [Golden Apple], they gain an additional 40% of Idunn's ATK for 10s.

upgrades.level2: If the target of the Ultimate is an ally with [Golden Apple], they gain an additional 30% CRIT Rate for 10s.
upgrades.level3: If the target of the Ultimate is an ally with [Golden Apple], they gain Super Armor for 10s.
upgrades.level4: If the target of the Ultimate is an ally with [Golden Apple], they gain an additional 30% CRIT DMG for 10s.

coreMechanic.summary: Golden Apple turns the nearest front-row ally into Idunn's dedicated carry. She shares base stats with that target, adds healing, shields, and damage reduction, then grants ATK, CRIT Rate, Super Armor, and CRIT DMG through Fruit of Eternity.

synergyLinks.description: Nut is an ideal Golden Apple target: Idunn reinforces her exposed frontline position with shared stats, missing-HP healing, shields, damage reduction, and offensive relic buffs.
Golden Apple gives Nezha the durability to stay in melee range, while Fruit of Eternity adds ATK, CRIT Rate, Super Armor, and CRIT DMG to his burst window.
Heracles benefits from the full Golden Apple package while ramping on the frontline, especially the extra survivability and control protection during Idunn's Ultimate.
Cancer adds frontline energy, healing, shields, and control protection, helping Idunn cast more reliably while layering protection on the Golden Apple carrier.
